items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible accordion with animated height transitions, spring-animated chevron, and fluid hover in grouped mode. Built on Radix UI Accordion.

items.name: ask-user-questions
items.title: Ask User Questions
items.description: Stepped question flow with numbered options, keyboard shortcuts (1–9), single or multi-select, inline 'other' text input, optional skip, fluid hover, and multi-question navigation. Auto-advances on selection in single-select.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact label with solid and dot variants, Tailwind color palette, and three sizes.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Status message built from parts (Banner, BannerTitle, BannerDescription, BannerActions, BannerAction): 5 statuses (filled glyphs for info, success, warning and error; the icon set's outline info icon for default), low or high contrast, primary, secondary and ghost actions (the library Button) that trail a one-line banner (primary at the edge) and drop under a description (primary first), a dismiss that collapses its height, and a fixed variant that sticks full-bleed to the top of the page.

items.name: base/accordion
items.title: Accordion (Base UI)
items.description: Collapsible accordion with animated height transitions, spring-animated chevron, and fluid hover in grouped mode. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/button
items.title: Button (Base UI)
items.description: Animated button with variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, loading spinner, and fluid font-weight transitions on hover. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group (Base UI)
items.description: Animated checkbox group with fluid hover, contiguous selection merging, and spring-animated check marks. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type-to-filter combobox with single or multiple (chips, merged selection backgrounds) selection: a text field that filters a list as you type, with keyboard highlight, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, animated checkmark, and clear/chevron controls. Optional create-from-query row (onCreate) and hideSelected for chips fields. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/dialog
items.title: Dialog (Base UI)
items.description: Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions in three widths (sm, lg, and an xl canvas for composed layouts such as a sidebar), plus a container prop to scope it to a region. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Dropdown menu with fluid hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem, DropdownSearch (a search field inside the popup), submenus (DropdownSub) whose trigger row stays lit across the safe area, and multiple selection with merged backgrounds. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/mobile-drawer
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/radio-group
items.title: Radio Group (Base UI)
items.description: Animated radio group with fluid hover, spring-animated selection dot. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area (Base UI)
items.description: Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Base UI flavor; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: base/select
items.title: Select
items.description: Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/slider
items.title: Slider (Base UI)
items.description: Animated slider with spring-snapped thumb, step dots, range mode, and click-to-edit value display. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/switch
items.title: Switch (Base UI)
items.description: Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation and fluid font-weight label transitions. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/tabs
items.title: Tabs (Base UI)

items.name: base/tabs-subtle

items.description: Horizontal tab navigation with fluid hover, animated pill selection indicator, and fluid font-weight transitions. Base UI flavor.

items.name: base/thinking-steps
items.title: Thinking Steps

items.name: base/tooltip

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Animated button with variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, loading spinner, and fluid font-weight transitions on hover.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn's compositional card (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter) with the Fluid Functionalism layer: transparent substrate, weight-animated title, media/logo/feature/image slots, and a CardGroup that owns stacked, inline, and grid layouts plus 2-D fluid-hover highlighting.

items.name: carousel-dots
items.title: Carousel Dots
items.description: Carousel dots, static or on autoplay: fluid-hover click areas, and a current pill that fills over each slide's duration.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: A single chat transcript entry with baked-in entrance and layout motion. Right-aligned accent bubble for the user, left-aligned muted bubble for the assistant, with optional file attachments. Adapts to the global shape setting.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: Animated checkbox group with fluid hover, contiguous selection merging, and spring-animated check marks. Built on Radix UI Checkbox.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Color picker with HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH formats, alpha channel, optional swatches, and a popover trigger. Built on Base UI's Popover, Menu, and NumberField primitives with native EyeDropper support.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type-to-filter combobox with single or multiple (chips, merged selection backgrounds) selection: a text field that filters a list as you type, with keyboard highlight, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, animated checkmark, and clear/chevron controls. Optional create-from-query row (onCreate) and hideSelected for chips fields. Radix flavor (Popover + hand-rolled listbox).

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: Search field over a list of actions: type to filter, arrows to move the fluid hover highlight, Enter to run. Grouped rows with icons, descriptions, and shortcut caps; suggestions listed first while nothing is typed; subtle tabs or a borderless filter bar under the field; and a dialog shell opened by a global shortcut (default ⌘K / Ctrl+K). The list needs no primitive; the dialog is the library's Dialog in either flavor.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions in three widths (sm, lg, and an xl canvas for composed layouts such as a sidebar), plus a container prop to scope it to a region. Built on Radix UI Dialog with overlay, header, footer, title, and description sub-components.

items.name: dialog-sidebar
items.title: Settings Dialog (Sidebar in a Dialog)
items.description: A settings dialog: the xl Dialog as a canvas, a non-collapsing Sidebar of sections down its left edge, and a scrolling panel of controls — switches, selects, and an input group. Below the sm breakpoint a Select takes over navigation.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Dropdown menu with fluid hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem, DropdownSearch (a search field inside the popup), submenus (DropdownSub) whose trigger row stays lit across the safe area, and multiple selection with merged backgrounds. Radix flavor.

items.name: file-thumbnail
items.title: File Thumbnail
items.description: Read-only square preview of a File. Images render via object-cover; PDFs render their first page via pdfjs; a spinner shows while either resolves. Adapts its corner radius to the global shape setting.

items.name: input-copy
items.title: Input Copy
items.description: Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button and animated check feedback. Supports optional label and shape context.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Grouped input fields with fluid hover highlighting, animated label transitions, optional icons, and error states.

items.name: input-message
items.title: Input Message
items.description: Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea, drag-and-drop file attachments (PNG / JPEG / PDF), flexible left/right action slots, and a built-in send button on a Surface-2 substrate.

items.name: mobile-drawer
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Radix flavor.

items.name: queued-stack
items.title: Queued message stack
items.description: Sonner-style stack of queued composer messages: collapsed cards fan out on hover (tap on touch), drag to reorder, a gutter arrow counts the overflow, edit/remove per card, and a shared-layout morph into the sent message.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Animated radio group with fluid hover, spring-animated selection dot, and optional Radix UI integration. Supports both controlled index and value-based APIs.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Page reveals in 1 class, on the existing spring tiers: slow for landing, moderate for product. .reveal-landing for a page read once: the hero rises and scales in on load, later sections do on scroll, and every section leaves the same way at the top; .reveal-scroll makes a deeper element, like a grid card, a section of its own. .reveal-product for the app: blocks fade in on load, nothing on scroll. Each has a -subtle step. For slow data, .reveal-swap crossfades shadcn's Skeleton into the real block and .reveal-items brings rows in one by one. Pure CSS; reduced motion keeps the fades and drops the rest.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Built on Radix UI Scroll Area; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark. Radix flavor.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Radix flavor.

items.name: sidebar-app
items.title: App Sidebar
items.description: A complete app shell: workspace header with the peek cross-fade, search on the menu rows' rhythm with a hover-revealed shortcut chip, collapsible sections with label actions and badges, a user footer, and an inset topbar whose trigger fades back in at its settled position after a pin.

items.name: sidebar-inset-topbar
items.title: Sidebar Inset Topbar
items.description: The main region's topbar: h-12 with the trigger that hides while the rail peeks and fades back in at its settled spot after a pin.

items.name: sidebar-search-field
items.title: Sidebar Search Field
items.description: Header search on the menu rows' rhythm: leading icon on the rows' 16px axis, text on the 32px axis, and a hover-revealed keystroke chip at the trailing edge.

items.name: sidebar-user-footer
items.title: Sidebar User Footer
items.description: Footer identity row: a 20px avatar centred on the rows' leading icon axis, chevron on the trailing action axis, and an upward user menu on the shared sidebar grid so its rows align with the trigger exactly.

items.name: sidebar-workspace-header
items.title: Sidebar Workspace Header
items.description: Workspace brand row for a sidebar header: 20px tile on the rows' leading axis, name pinned to the 32px text axis, trigger cross-fading into the tile's slot while the collapsed rail peeks, and a trigger-width switcher menu on the shared sidebar grid.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Animated slider with spring-snapped thumb, step dots, range mode, and click-to-edit value display. Built on Radix UI Slider.

items.name: surfaces
items.title: Surfaces
items.description: Eight-level surface and shadow ladder for elevation. Light: two color steps then flat white, differentiated by shadow. Dark: additive white-opacity ladder with layered inset highlights and drops.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation and fluid font-weight label transitions. Built on Radix UI Switch.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Animated table with fluid hover row highlighting and fluid border transitions. Includes TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, and TableCell sub-components.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented control tabs with sliding active indicator, fluid hover, and spring animations. Built on Radix UI Tabs.

items.name: tabs-subtle
items.title: Tabs Subtle
items.description: Horizontal tab navigation with fluid hover, animated pill selection indicator, and fluid font-weight transitions. Radix flavor.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: Animated loading indicator with morphing SVG path (circle to infinity loop) and shimmer text rotation. Cycles through customizable status words.

items.name: thinking-steps
items.title: Thinking Steps
items.description: Collapsible AI reasoning steps with animated expand/collapse, per-step icons, sources, and nested details. Radix flavor.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Interaction Tokens
items.description: Shared interaction-state tokens: surface-relative hover/active overlays (bg-hover, bg-active), the selected fill, the see-through secondary-button tint (--tint, --tint-hover), the destructive-light ground, the --overlay RGB triplet, the --focus-ring color, and the base-layer :focus-visible fallback ring.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Floating tooltip with spring-based animations, configurable placement, and rich content support.

items.name: type-scale
items.title: Type Scale
items.description: Six type roles (display, title, subtitle, body, caption, micro), each a font size and a line height, at the default and compact steps of the size ladder. Adds text-<role> utilities and the --fs-* / --lh-* variables components read.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The type scale and prose styles in one install. size-context brings the 6 roles, typeClass(), and the --fs-* / --lh-* tokens; the prose styles set rendered markdown and rich-text editors (Tiptap works as is) in those roles: wrap content in .typeset, and h1 is display in bold, h2 title, h3 to h6 subtitle, paragraphs body in the muted color, figcaption and code caption. Zero specificity inside @layer components, so any utility wins; .not-typeset opts a subtree out; spacing only above elements, so streamed content never reflows. Add .typeset-compact for the compact step.
